shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
human figure (A as the monolithic body itself, B as figures in profile)
curved arc / crescent-like motifs (A's incised bands; B's ram horns)
areas of dense repeated incised texture (A's shallow patterning; B's fleece and beard hatching)
justification: Both are stone surfaces worked in shallow relief with passages of repetitive incised texture and curved motifs, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a massive, weathered three-dimensional monolith whose back bears isolated abstract signs (disc, arcs, bands) with no narrative order, while B is a flat, pale, finely cut panel with a friezelike procession of profile human figures and horned animals in strict registers on a groundline.
